content: Řeḥwic n tzayart n Nabut
Awarni tmesřayin-a aqa din min imsaren ak-d Nabut, Ayazraɛili, wenni ɣar iǧa ijj n umarjeɛ n uḍiř di Yazraɛil zzat i řeqṣar n Axab, ajeǧid n Samarya.

Axab issiweř ak-d Nabut, inna: “Ewc ayi amarjeɛ nnec n uḍiř, ḥima ad ɣari yiři d taḥwic tazizawt, maɣar aqa tudes i taddart inu. Necc ad ac wceɣ deg wemcan nnes ijj n umarjeɛ nneɣni n uḍiř iṣbeḥ xas, niɣ mařa man aya d lemliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnec, ad cek xeǧṣeɣ ttman nnes s ttmenyat n nnuqart.”
Maca Nabut inna i Axab: “SIDI ad ayi iḥḍa, aqa ad ac wceɣ tasɣart n řejdud inu!”

Uca iɛqeb Axab ɣar taddart nnes s řxaḍar ixsaren d ixeyyiqen zi ssibbet n wawař i kides issiweř Nabut, Ayazraɛili, umi inna: “Necc war d ac tticeɣ tasɣart n řejdud inu.” U netta izzeř x qama nnes, yarra aɣembub nnes ɣar řḥiḍ, war icci aɣrum.
Tamɣart nnes Izabal tusa-dd ɣares, tessiweř akides: “Min din ařami řxaḍar nnec ixsar ammu u war tᵉttetted aɣrum?”

Netta issiweř akides: “Maɣar necc ssiwřeɣ ak-d Nabut, Ayazraɛili, nniɣ as: ‘Ewc ayi amarjeɛ nnec n uḍiř i ttmenyat n nnuqart, niɣ, mařa texsed ad ac wceɣ ijj n umarjeɛ n uḍiř nneɣni deg wemcan nnes!’, maca netta inna: ‘Necc war d ac tticeɣ amarjeɛ inu n uḍiř!’”
Tenna as temɣart nnes Izabal: “Ma xenni cek ttegged ixef nnec d ajeǧid x Israil? Kkar, ecc aɣrum u ejj uř nnec ad yiři mliḥ! Necc ad ac wceɣ amarjeɛ n uḍiř n Nabut, Ayazraɛili.”
Nettat tura tibratin x yisem n Axab uca tcemmeɛ i-tent s txaḍent nnes n ucemmiɛ u tessekk tibratin nni i imeqqranen u i tarwa n taṣiřet nni tuɣa izeddɣen ɣar Nabut di tendint nnes.
Di tebratin tura, tenna: “Barrḥem s yijj n uẓummi u sɣimem Nabut ɣar zzat n marra řgens
uca sbeddem tnayen n iryazen, ayt i war isekkwin, qibač nnes, ḥima ad xas cehden, ad inin: ‘Cek tceqqfed di AREBBI u deg ujeǧid!’ Sufɣem t xenni ɣar barra u arejmem t ař d immet.”
Iryazen n tendint, imeqqranen d tarwa n taṣiřet nni tuɣa izeddɣen di tendint nnes, ggin ɛlaḥsab min d asen tumur Izabal, am mammec yurin di tebratin nni tuɣa d asen dd-tessekk.
Nitni barrḥen s yijj n uẓummi u ssɣimen Nabut ɣar zzat n marra řgens.

Xenni usin-dd tnayen n yeryazen, ayt i war isekkwin, uca qqimen qibač nnes. Iryazen i war isekkwin cehden xas, x Nabut, zzat i řgens, nnan: “Nabut iceqqef di SIDI u deg ujeǧid.” Xenni ssuffɣen t barra i tendint uca arejmen t ařami immut.
Awarni as jjin ad inin i Izabal: “Nabut ittwarjem u immut.”

Umi tesřa Izabal aqa Nabut ittwarjem, immut, imsar, aqa Izabal tenna i Axab: “Kkar, ksi amarjeɛ n uḍiř n Nabut, Ayazraɛili, d řwart, aḥwic i yugin netta ad ac t iwc s ttmenyat n nnuqqart, maɣar Nabut war iddar ca ɛad, maca immut.”
Umi isřa Axab, belli Nabut immut, imsar, aqa Axab ikkar, maḥend ad ihwa ɣar umarjeɛ n uḍiř n Nabut, Ayazraɛili, ḥima ad t iksi d řwart.
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Iliya, Aticbi, inna:
“Kkar, hwa, ḥima ad temmeřqid ak-d Axab, ajeǧid n Israil, wenni iǧan di Samarya. Xzar, netta deg umarjeɛ n uḍiř n Nabut mani ɣar dd-ihwa, ḥima ad t iksi d řwart.

Ittxeṣṣa ad kides tessiwřed, ad tinid: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Ma tenɣid u xenni tekksed uřa d tasɣart?’ Ɛawed ittxeṣṣa ad kides tessiwřed, ad tinid: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Deg wemcan mani řesḥen iṭan idammen n Nabut, ad řesḥen iṭan uřa d idammen nnec, wah, d inni nnec!’”
Inna Axab i Iliya: “Ma tufid ayi, cek, řeɛdu inu?” Netta inna: “Necc ufiɣ cek minzi cek tezzenzed ixef nnec, maḥend ad tegged min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI.
Xzar Necc ad xak ssiwḍeɣ řɣar u ad mḥiɣ min iqqimen nnec. Ad teḥḥiɣ marra wi t itteggen x řḥiḍ, am wenni ittwaṭṭfen, am wenni umi jjin di Israil.
Necc ad arreɣ taddart nnec am taddart n Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, u am taddart n Baɛca, mmis n Axiya, zi ssibbet n wesɛar i zi d ayi tesɛared, u umi tarrid Israil ad ixḍa.”
Issiweř SIDI uřa x Izabal, inna: “Iṭan ad ccen Izabal ɣar řḥiḍ n zzat n Yazraɛil.
Man wen zi Axab i ɣa immuten di tendint, ad t ccen iṭan u man wen i ɣa immuten deg iyyar ad t ccen ijḍaḍ n ujenna.”
Uřa d ijj war iǧi ɛemmarṣ am Axab i izzenzen ixef nnes, ḥima ad yegg min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, am t tɛarren temɣart nnes Izabal.
Netta igga min iǧan d jjɛifect ař ṭṭarf umi yareddef imeyḍa n l’aṣnam nsen u umi igga ɛlaḥsab marra min iggin Imuriyyen nni tuɣa issuffeɣ SIDI zi řwart zzat i wudem n ayt n Israil.
Umi isřa Axab awařen-a, ibda ad icarreg arruḍ nnes, yarḍ ict txancet n wecḍan x arrimet nnes, iẓumm. Ɛawed iṭṭeṣ deg ict n txancet u yuyur s arexwan.
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Iliya, Aticbi, inna:
“Ma teẓrid mammec issehwa Axab ixef nnes zzat i wudem inu? Minzi issehwa ixef nnes zzat i wudem inu, necc war ssikkʷiḍeɣ řɣar deg wussan nnes, maca deg wussan n mmis ad ssiwḍeɣ řɣar x taddart nnes.”
